front: Effect of higher tax on profits?
back: Less profit after tax for owners and for reinvestment; may discourage investment.
Lower disposable income, lower demand (especially luxuries); workers may ask for pay rises.

front: Effects of a rise in interest rates?
back: Dearer loans, lower profit, less investment, lower consumer spending (esp. credit purchases), more saving.
More contracts and demand (construction, suppliers), better infrastructure, more income for public workers.
Repay loans, use retained profit, reduce stock, delay expansion, cheaper products.
